summary.headline: A study-and-travel chart: the 9th house of higher learning and long journeys holds Jupiter and Saturn, and Saturn, the lord of your 5th house of education, runs your major period until 2033. Study abroad is well supported; the strongest stretch for it is the Rahu sub-period from February 2028, with the second half of 2027 as an earlier, workable start.

key_points.text: Higher study fits your chart well: the lord of your 5th house of education, Saturn, sits with Jupiter in the 9th house of higher learning and foreign travel, and Saturn runs your current major period.

For a master's abroad, the earliest workable start is when Jupiter moves into your 12th house of foreign places in late June 2027; the firmer stretch is the Rahu sub-period, which begins in February 2028.

Your roots pull strongly: the lord of the 12th house (foreign lands), the Sun, sits in your 4th house of home together with your lagna lord Mercury. A long spell abroad is likely, while ties to India stay active.

Your mind is analytical and technical rather than purely academic. Mercury, which rules both your lagna and your 10th house of career, is in its own sign in the career chart (D10), and Rahu in the 10th favours technology and large organisations. Applied research in industry fits better than either extreme.

Until about February 2028, effort feels heavier than its reward: Saturn is in the last phase of its transit over the Moon (Sade Sati), with a break from June to October 2027 when Saturn steps into Aries, and it is opposite your lagna this winter. Steady routines carry you through it.

lagna.text: You think carefully, check details and like to understand how things work before you trust them. Virgo rises (the intake page shows how the 00:00 birth time is read), and Jupiter aspects the 1st house. Your lagna lord Mercury sits in the 4th house in Sagittarius with the Sun and Ketu, so you learn best from a settled base and keep close ties to home and family. Mercury is also combust (very close to the Sun), which describes a mind that works hard behind the scenes and needs to put its ideas in its own words.

moon.text: Your feelings settle through work, problem-solving and a daily rhythm, and you can be hard on yourself when routines slip. The Moon is in Aquarius, in the nakshatra Purva Bhadrapada, in your 6th house, together with Venus. It is the strongest planet in the chart by Shadbala, which gives you emotional stamina. The sources disagree on one pattern here. By Varahamihira's narrow test (nothing in the 2nd or 12th from the Moon) the Kemadruma pattern is present, but by the BPHS test it does not hold (it is cancelled), since Venus is with the Moon and Mercury is in an angle. Read it as a mild tendency to self-reliance; asking for help early is a skill worth building.

sun.text: Your sense of purpose is tied to home, family values and the place you come from. The Sun is in Sagittarius in your 4th house and rules the 12th house of foreign places and distant settings. Wherever you go, you will want a base that feels like home.

current_period.text: Since July 2014 you have been in Saturn's major period, which runs to July 2033. Saturn rules your 5th house of education and your 6th house of work and exams, and sits in the 9th house of higher learning, so these years are about building qualifications the slow, solid way. The Moon sub-period (to January 2027) brings exams, deadlines and routines forward. The Mars sub-period (January 2027 to February 2028) adds drive and paperwork. The Rahu sub-period that follows, to the end of 2030, opens foreign settings and technology. The Jupiter sub-period (December 2030 to July 2033) favours recognition and settling.

yogas.text: Several classical yogas hold. Budhaditya (the Sun and Mercury together) describes sharp intelligence and a talent for explaining things. Jupiter, lord of the 4th and 7th houses, sits in the 9th trine, a classical Raja-yoga link between an angle and a trine. Kesari (Jupiter in an angle from the Moon) and Adhi yoga (a benefic in the 6th, 7th or 8th) add protection and steady progress. A second Raja-yoga reading of Jupiter and Saturn is disputed between the sources and is not relied on here.

strengths.text: Your emotional stamina is your biggest asset: the Moon ranks first in Shadbala, followed by Saturn. Only the Sun falls just below its classical minimum. In Ashtakavarga the 4th (35 points), 2nd and 11th (34 each) houses are the best supported, so home, earnings and gains are reliable in the long run. The 5th house of study scores lowest (20), so learning pays off through regular effort rather than flair.

transits.text: Saturn is now in Pisces, your 7th house and the 2nd from the Moon: this is the setting phase of Sade Sati, and it asks for patience with others and with money. Jupiter is in Leo, your 12th house, which favours foreign contacts and applications. Rahu is in Aquarius over your Moon and moves into your 5th house of studies in December 2026.

overview.text: In the Lal Kitab chart house 4 is crowded and awake: the Sun and Mercury there together act as an artificial exalted Mars, which the book reads as energy and drive rising from the home. Ketu in house 4 and Saturn in house 9 are both in the 'dharmi' (righteous) state, which softens them. Jupiter sits in house 9, its own pakka ghar. The Moon, Venus, Mars and Jupiter are in placements the book calls 'sinful', which is its term for a placement it reads as less helpful, not a judgement of you. The Moon and Venus in house 6 are asleep by both editions' tests.

debts.text: Both editions show the same three debt signatures under different names: one linked to the mother (matri: the Moon, with Mercury or Ketu in house 4); one for sisters and daughters (Mercury, with the Moon in house 6); and one the 1952 edition calls 'dargahi' and the knowledge base calls 'kudrati' (Ketu, with the Moon in house 6). The 1952 edition judges a debt across the family's charts, so these are patterns to be aware of, not declared debts.

varshaphal.text: In the annual chart for your 26th year (to December 2026), Mars moves into house 1, which the book reads as energy and initiative for you personally. Jupiter and Saturn move into house 12, so spending, travel plans and preparation for a move are in focus. The Sun and Mercury move into house 8, which asks for care with documents and applications.

indicators.text: You look for a partner who is principled, educated or from a different background. The lord of your 7th house, Jupiter, sits in the 9th house of higher learning and distant places.
Affection often grows out of shared work or study rather than sudden attraction: Venus sits with the Moon in the 6th house.
The upapada (the Jaimini point for marriage) is in Aries, whose lord Mars is in your 2nd house of family. Commitment for you is tied to family approval and to building a stable household.

current_period.text: For now, study and work come first in Saturn's major period. Relationships come more into view in the later Jupiter sub-period, when the 7th lord itself is active.

cautions.text: You take relationships seriously and slowly, so give decisions time: your 7th lord Jupiter is retrograde and shares its house with Saturn.

You may hear about Kuja (Mangal) conventions. Counted from the lagna, Mars in your 2nd house meets the popular convention and the Hora (HJH2) convention, but not the BPHS one. The conventions disagree with each other and are a matter of convention, not a verdict on any relationship.

indicators.text: Your work is likely to involve technology, communication or large, international organisations: Rahu sits in the 10th house in Gemini, the sign of Mercury.

Analysis and precise thinking are what you get paid for. Your 10th lord Mercury is the lagna lord too, it is the Amatyakaraka (the Jaimini significator of career), and it is in its own sign Gemini in the career chart (D10).
You do your best work going deep on one subject from a stable base, with Mercury in the 4th house alongside the Sun and Ketu.

current_period.text: Qualifications come before a full career start in these years, with Saturn running your major period from the 9th house of higher learning. This winter Saturn's transit opposite your lagna makes the final months of your degree demanding.

windows.text: Offers, admissions and support from seniors.

windows.label: Rahu sub-period
windows.text: A technology career, often abroad, as Rahu in the 10th is activated.

cautions.text: Your contribution can be overshadowed by seniors, because Mercury is combust; keep a record of your own work and present it yourself.
You may feel restless about direction (Rahu in the 10th). Choose roles on the skills they build, not on the title alone.

indicators.text: Earnings are well supported over the long run: the 2nd house of savings and the 11th house of gains each score 34 points in Ashtakavarga.
Your income comes mainly through salaried work and service rather than through ventures of your own, because the lords of the 11th (the Moon) and the 2nd (Venus) are both in the 6th house of jobs.
You are quick to spend on goals you care about (Mars in the 2nd house); a simple budget keeps that in check.

current_period.text: Small earnings through internships, stipends or projects are possible in the Moon sub-period, to January 2027, which activates your 11th lord; the main focus is still study.

windows.label: Jupiter in your 2nd house (first pass)
windows.text: A first, short lift for earnings; you may still be studying then, so read it as first stipends or project income rather than a settled salary (an inference).

windows.label: Jupiter in your 2nd house (second pass)
windows.text: The clearest supportive stretch for a steady salary and savings.

windows.label: Jupiter in your 2nd house (third pass)
windows.text: Jupiter's last pass through the 2nd house confirms what the second pass started.

cautions.text: The setting phase of Sade Sati (Saturn 2nd from the Moon) makes money feel tight until about February 2028, with a break from June to October 2027. Keep study costs and loans within a plan you can repay; this is guidance, not financial advice, so check the plan with a qualified adviser.

indicators.text: Long journeys for study are clearly shown: Jupiter and Saturn, the significators of learning and of long effort, sit in the 9th house of higher education and travel.
Your travel is tied to career and technology rather than tourism: Rahu, the classical significator of foreign settings, is in your 10th house.
Time abroad tends to stay connected to India and to family, because the 12th lord, the Sun, sits in the 4th house of home.

current_period.text: Travel for study is already in the air in Saturn's major period, which runs from the 9th house; the Rahu sub-period from February 2028 is its most foreign-oriented part.

windows.label: Jupiter enters your 12th house
windows.text: An earlier, workable start for study abroad.

windows.label: Jupiter in your 12th house again
windows.text: It coincides with the start of the Rahu sub-period: the stronger window.

cautions.text: Expect delays with visas or paperwork, and apply early: the 9th house is only borderline in Ashtakavarga (25 points) and both planets in it are retrograde.

indicators.text: Postgraduate study fits your chart: the 5th lord Saturn sits in the 9th house of higher learning, alongside Jupiter, the natural significator of knowledge.
You learn by depth and repetition rather than by cramming. The 5th house scores lowest in Ashtakavarga (20 points), but Mars and Jupiter aspect it, which gives drive and good guidance.
Budhaditya yoga (the Sun with Mercury) supports technical and analytical subjects and clear writing.

current_period.text: Finishing your degree well is the priority now; the Moon sub-period, to January 2027, puts exams and routines (the 6th house) in focus.

windows.label: Jupiter in your 11th house
windows.text: Admissions, scholarships and letters of support.

windows.label: Jupiter crosses your lagna
windows.text: Good for settling into a programme and for confidence.

cautions.text: Interest in new subjects rises from December 2026, but so do distractions, as Rahu enters your 5th house of study. Choose a focused programme rather than switching fields at the last minute.

indicators.text: Home is your anchor: the 4th house is the best supported in Ashtakavarga (35 points) and holds the Sun, Mercury and Ketu.
Teachers and your father's values shape you: the 9th house holds Jupiter and Saturn, the significators of guidance and duty.
Your mother's care is practical and shows through effort more than words: the Moon, the significator of the mother, sits in the 6th house of service.

current_period.text: Your mother and the home come into focus while you prepare to leave, in the Moon sub-period to January 2027.

family.no_window_reason: This report does not give timing for children or family additions; that is a personal and medical matter. Timing for moves and study appears in the foreign and education chapters.

cautions.text: At times you may feel detached from home even while you value it (Ketu in the 4th); keep regular contact with family while you are away.

indicators.text: Stress shows first in sleep, appetite and routine, because the Moon sits in the 6th house; a fixed daily rhythm is your main wellness lever.
Your recovery is steady: the Moon ranks first in Shadbala and the 6th house scores 29 points, about average.

current_period.text: The exam season is tiring, with the Moon sub-period and the last phase of Sade Sati running together. Protect sleep and regular meals.

cautions.text: Overwork builds up quietly because Saturn aspects the 6th house. Take breaks before you need them, and see a doctor for any physical concern.

indicators.text: A disciplined, study-based path suits you: Jupiter and Saturn in the 9th house of dharma favour regular practice and learning from teachers.
An inner quietness grows with age, and time alone helps you more than crowds: Ketu sits in the 4th house.

current_period.text: A simple practice kept up over years suits these years better than intense bursts; Saturn's major period runs from the 9th house of dharma.

windows.label: Saturn returns to its birth position
windows.text: A time to review your direction and beliefs. Saturn returns to its birth position in your 9th house from late 2029, steps back into Aries from October 2029, and crosses its birth position again in April 2030.

cautions.text: You can become rigid about rules (Saturn with Jupiter); keep practice short and kind to yourself.

answers.answer: The chart supports it. Postgraduate study is one of the clearest promises in your chart: Saturn, lord of your 5th house of education, sits with Jupiter in the 9th house of higher learning and long journeys, and Saturn runs your major period until 2033. For timing, Jupiter moving into your 12th house of foreign places from late June 2027 makes an autumn 2027 start workable. The stronger window is the Rahu sub-period from February 2028, when Jupiter is again in your 12th house (late February to July 2028), which suits an autumn 2028 start. Use the first half of 2027, when Jupiter is in your 11th house of gains, for applications and scholarships.
answers.short: A good idea; apply in early 2027, and go in autumn 2027 or, more strongly, in 2028.

answers.what_to_do: Finish your degree strongly first. Shortlist programmes and take entrance tests in early 2027. If the offer or funding for 2027 is weak, a gap year working in industry and starting in 2028 is fully in keeping with the chart.

answers.answer: The chart points to a long spell abroad followed by strong ties to India, not a clean either-or. Rahu in your 10th house, activated in the Rahu sub-period, favours work abroad after your studies. But the lord of your 12th house (foreign lands), the Sun, sits in your 4th house of home together with your lagna lord Mercury, and the 4th house is the strongest in Ashtakavarga. Looking further ahead than this report's five-year timing, the tradition would look to the Mercury major period from mid-2033, run by that same home-based lagna lord, for a return or at least a firm base in India. This is a choice you will make, and the chart shows tendencies, not a fixed outcome.
answers.short: Several years abroad are likely; the tradition would look to the Mercury period from mid-2033 for a stronger pull home.

evidence.text: Rahu in the 10th house, activated in the Rahu sub-period
12th lord Sun with lagna lord Mercury in the 4th house; the 4th house strongest in Ashtakavarga
The Mercury major period from mid-2033, run by the lagna lord in the 4th house

answers.what_to_do: Plan your first job abroad as a stage of a few years, not a permanent decision, and keep your professional network in India alive. Review the question from late 2029, when Saturn returns to its birth position.

answers.answer: Applied research in industry suits you best. On the research side, Jupiter and Saturn in the 9th house of higher learning favour deep study, and Mercury with Ketu in the 4th gives the focus for long problems. On the industry side, Rahu in your 10th house in Gemini, and Mercury in its own sign in the career chart (D10), point to technology, scale and practical results. An R&D, data or engineering-research role in a company, or a research-oriented master's with industry links, uses both. A pure academic path is possible but is the less natural fit, because the career house itself is held by Rahu.
answers.short: Applied research in industry (R&D) fits better than either pure option.

evidence.text: Jupiter and Saturn in the 9th house of higher learning
Rahu in the 10th; 10th lord Mercury in its own sign in D10

answers.what_to_do: Choose a master's with a thesis or project done with industry partners. Try one research internship and one industry internship before deciding, and judge them by the work, not the title.
answers.no_window_reason: This is a question of fit rather than timing; the career chapter and the timeline show when the Rahu sub-period opens technology roles.

answers.answer: Income becomes steady once study is behind you, most clearly from the second half of 2029. Your 2nd and 11th houses of earnings and gains are both strong in Ashtakavarga (34 points each), and their lords, Venus and the Moon, sit in the 6th house of jobs, so salaried work is your main source. Until about February 2028 the last phase of Sade Sati keeps money tight, with a break from June to October 2027. Jupiter passes through your 2nd house three times: December 2028 to March 2029, August 2029 to January 2030, and May to September 2030. The first pass may fall while you are still studying, so it reads more as first earnings (an inference); the second is the first clearly supportive stretch for a steady salary and savings, and the Jupiter sub-period from December 2030 consolidates it. These are tendencies, not guarantees.
answers.short: Tight until about February 2028; steady from late 2029, consolidating from December 2030.

answers.what_to_do: Keep study loans modest and plan repayment against a realistic first salary. Start automatic saving with your first job, however small. This is guidance, not financial advice; check the plan with a qualified adviser.

vedic.instructions: On Saturdays, a short prayer or chant in your own tradition and a small act of service to an elder or a worker (helping, sharing food). Continue for a few months; stop whenever you wish.
